title: Metabolomic Profiles During and After a Hypertensive Disorder of Pregnancy: The EPOCH Study.
summary: The antepartum metabolomic pattern continued to distinguish cases in postpartum and mid-life samples; the strength of discrimination declined over time. The study includes antepartum, postpartum, and a separate mid-life participant group, but all were recruited through one center; the authors call for replication in other cohorts.
ai_technology: Machine learning on measured plasma metabolites identified multivariate signatures and ranked features that distinguished cases from controls.
